text:
sam.t: hey team, first day laptop question. got a MacBook Pro (M2, serial RT9876ABC). after logging in the Company Setup app shows "Management Pending" and Finder says my disk is not encrypted. also when i try to run Docker it fails with "bad CPU type in executable". i tried installing homebrew but it asks for admin privileges. who do i bug for admin or a quick re-enroll?

mdm-bot: new device detected serial=RT9876ABC. enrollment_state=pending. Self-service re-enroll: https://idp.redwood.example.com/self-service. If on guest network, switch to corp-secure or use corp-vpn.

sam.t: ahh i'm on guest wifi atm. i'm remote. will try corp-vpn. quick question: is FileVault supposed to be enabled immediately? fdesetup returns "FileVault is Off".

tara.it: welcome! corp-guest is isolated so MDM webhooks won't reach the device. Connect to corp-vpn then retry the Company Setup -> Re-enroll. FileVault is typically pushed by Jamf after enrollment; it may prompt you to enable with your corp account.

javier.sre: to help debug paste the outputs of these two commands (short lines only):
```
/usr/bin/fdesetup status
profiles show --type enrollment
```

sam.t: pasted:
```
FileVault is Off
Enrollment status: Pending
MDM Server: jamf.redwood.local
```

maria-devex: fyi sometimes DEP (Device Enrollment Program) state shows pending if the DEP token expired; we've seen cases where the device needs a manual push from IT. tara can check the DEP console.

tara.it: opened IT ticket IT-4899 with serial + screenshot. i'll attempt a remote enrollment push now. if remote push doesn't finish we can grant you a temporary sudo account for 12 hours to install Rosetta and Docker. please include the exact error you see for Docker in the ticket.

mdm-bot: re-enroll task queued for RT9876ABC (job=2026-03-10-12). status: queued -> running.

sam.t: docker error is: "zsh: /usr/local/bin/docker: bad CPU type in executable". seems like Rosetta missing.

javier.sre: that's Rosetta territory. once you have admin run: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. after that install Docker for Apple Silicon. also prefer the official Apple Silicon build; x86 binaries will fail without Rosetta.

tara.it: re-enroll finished and device now shows Managed. i'm pushing the FileVault profile which will prompt you to enable encryption; it should also request enabling a bootstrap token for escrow.

mdm-bot: filevault_profile_push job=2026-03-10-13 status: in_progress.

sam.t: got a system dialog asking to enable FileVault and to enter a user to enable. it lists my corp email sam.t@redwood.com. should i proceed?

tara.it: yes go ahead and enable. note the recovery URL/key will be stored in our MDM escrow. after enabling run `fdesetup status` and paste the line. we'll also rotate the bootstrap token shortly.

sam.t: did it. `fdesetup status` now: `FileVault is On.` woo! :party:

javier.sre: awesome. have you installed Rosetta & Docker yet?

sam.t: yes, tara gave me a 12h sudo grant. installed rosetta, installed Docker Desktop (Apple Silicon) and Homebrew works now. containers start.

tara.it: temporary admin will auto-expire. ticket IT-4899 updated with actions and expiry timestamp. please add a short note of commands you ran so we can add to onboarding docs.

maria-devex: huge thanks and welcome. we'll add a short section in the new-hires runbook about corp-guest vs corp-vpn and the re-enroll flow.

sam.t: will file the steps in the ticket. thanks everyone for the quick help!
